title: Microsoft Teams: QR code images from external senders are blurred by default
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents default QR code blurring, the recipient's reveal option and the absence of an administrator on/off control. The external-domain controls and Teams licensing statement are supported, and the briefing correctly distinguishes the roadmap target from the updated tenant-notice rollout window.

claims.claim: Teams blurs images containing QR codes in messages from external senders.
claims.quote: When an external user sends a message that contains an image with a QR code, Teams blurs the image.
